record.name: Descending-price funded opening
record.summary: Buy finite funded inventory as its quoted price falls, then switch to ordinary pool trading after closing or sellout.

units.amounts: Raw currency/token units; no display/value conversion
units.liquidity: Actual core L, not token balances or economic value
units.time: Absolute UTC seconds; inclusive starts and exclusive sale/commit/reveal ends
units.identity: Maker/holder/bidder/router identity is exactly the source-defined account, not inferred human diversity

fields.name: currency0
fields.label: Currency0
fields.help: The lower address in the actual ordered plain ERC20 pair.

fields.name: currency1
fields.label: Currency1
fields.help: The higher address in the actual ordered plain ERC20 pair.

fields.name: sqrtPriceX96
fields.label: Initial pool sqrt price
fields.units: Q64.96 sqrt(raw currency1/currency0); not a display-token price
fields.help: Review both token decimals and initial pool price. Opening/auction prices do not set or move this AMM price.

fields.name: saleIsCurrency0
fields.label: Sell currency0
fields.units: explicit sale side in the ordered currency pair
fields.help: True sells currency0 for currency1; false sells currency1 for currency0. All amounts use the selected raw-token units, not display-token prices.

fields.name: lotSize
fields.label: Sale units in a price lot
fields.units: raw sale-token units used as price denominator

fields.name: openingQuotePerLot
fields.label: Opening quote per lot
fields.help: At most int128.max. The nominal schedule falls over time; rounded fills also enforce the buyer’s effective per-lot cap.

fields.name: closingQuotePerLot
fields.label: Closing quote per lot
fields.help: Schedule endpoint reached at closesAt, when the sale is already closed. The last executable integer price can be higher; this endpoint is not a promised available fill.

fields.name: maximumSale
fields.label: Total sale inventory
fields.units: raw sale-token units; one exact funding transfer

fields.name: beneficiary
fields.label: Sale proceeds and unsold recipient
fields.help: All funding irrevocably supplies this fixed beneficiary. It is not a personal funder refund balance.

liveChecks.requirement: Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code, raw decimals and exact debit/credit behavior. Native, tax, rebase, restricted and dishonest assets are unsupported.
Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code, raw decimals and exact debit/credit behavior. Native, tax, rebase, restricted and dishonest assets are unsupported.
Recheck against the actual construction block timestamp; saved schedules may expire before deployment.
Recipient must differ from the predicted hook address; nonzero validation alone is insufficient.
The fixed beneficiary must differ from the actual Manager as well as the predicted hook.

Check full one-time maximumSale funding strictly before opensAt and its actual beneficiary-owned Manager claims. Any funder gifts this inventory and has no personal cancellation/refund right. Direct donations create no sale or claim credit.

During the funded opening, only quote-input/sale-output buys fill wholly. Require canonical128-byte DescendingSaleBounds with a reviewed effective maximum quote-per-lot, maximum quote input, minimum sale output and deadline<=closesAt; enforce both input/output bounds and rounded input*lotSize<=output*maxQuotePerLot. Use direction-canonical extreme core limits. Do not silently widen a user price cap to cover rounding.

Recheck live openingState, price, sold quantity, remaining inventory and inclusive deadline. Nonempty old sale hookData MUST refuse after closing or complete sellout; only explicitly reviewed empty data enters ordinary AMM trading. Closing/sellout neither seeds nor reprices that pool; later liquidity, core fee and actual router limits are separate.

Permissionless proceeds claims and at/after-close unsold refunds pay only the fixed beneficiary. Proceeds may require bounded chunks. Unused inventory, paid proceeds and sold units must reconcile to exact funded claims; failed final settlement rolls back sold/claim accounting.

definition.help: Nominal price is raw quote units per lotSize sale units, descending over at most 7 days. Opening quote per lot is at most int128.max and closing price cannot exceed it. Exact-input output rounds down; exact-output input rounds up. Buyers independently cap the actual rounded per-lot execution ratio, input, output and deadline. No partial fill or opening sells. The opening skips core LP/protocol fees; after close or sellout, a fresh empty-data intent uses the ordinary configured AMM fee/price. All proceeds and residual inventory belong to the fixed beneficiary. No auction fairness, AMM repricing, market-price, liquidity or end-wallet delivery guarantee.
